Container.Name: Mars Control Plane
Container.Overview: Mars control plane for Linux/amd64 (linux/amd64). Requires PostgreSQL 17 and an HTTPS reverse proxy or Cloudflare Tunnel with WebSocket support. Worker execution runtimes are external to Unraid.

Config.Name: Persistent data
Config.Description: Persistent control-plane data, including app_master_key. Back up this directory together with PostgreSQL; losing either makes encrypted credentials unrecoverable.

Config.Name: Public base URL
Config.Description: Required canonical HTTPS origin, for example https://<mars-hostname>.

Config.Name: GitHub webhook URL
Config.Description: Required public HTTPS origin root, normally https://<mars-hostname>; Mars appends /api/github/webhooks.

Config.Name: Worker base URL
Config.Description: Optional worker HTTPS origin. Leave empty to use PUBLIC_BASE_URL.
